about.metaDescription: Software developer for business applications, apps and AI integration. Trained translator, developing software since 2022, hosting in Germany.
about.subtitle: Software developer for business applications, apps and AI integration
about.block1P1: I studied Romance languages and translation in Jena and then lived and worked in Argentina, Uruguay and Chile. From 2017 to 2023 I worked as a self-employed translator in Berlin: with binding deadlines, confidential documents and clients who relied on me.
about.block1P2: I began developing software in 2022. Today I am responsible for projects from requirements analysis to server operations, including a specialist portal for a district administration with role-based access control and a multi-tenant platform for coaches. I used to translate between languages and cultures; today I translate human language into the language of software. The attitude has stayed the same: understand precisely first, then carry it over with care.
about.block2Title: How I work and where I'm heading
about.block2P1: You talk to the person who writes the code, from the first analysis to ongoing operation. I would rather choose the solid, maintainable solution than the spectacular one that nobody understands two years from now. I plan for security and data protection from the start, and the source code, documentation and access credentials belong to you.
about.block2P2: My goal is to support companies and organisations over the long term: with software that grows with them, with my own infrastructure in Germany, which I am currently building, and with my own products such as the platform for coaches. Learning new technologies and understanding them thoroughly is not a duty for me; it is the reason I enjoy this work.

items.title: Business applications and portals
items.text: I digitise business processes that standard software cannot handle: specialist portals with granular role and permission models, protected document areas, editorial workflows and interfaces to existing systems.

items.title: Apps and SaaS products
items.text: Client and member areas, scheduling and contract management, payment processing. Multi-tenant on request, so you can later offer your application as a product in its own right. I continue to develop it well beyond launch.

items.title: AI integration
items.text: I integrate large language models where they deliver measurable relief: analysing and classifying documents, drafting texts and replies, assistant features within existing applications. Privacy-compliant, traceable and with human approval at the decisive points.

items.title: Operations and infrastructure
items.text: I run your application on servers in Germany: containerised, hardened, with automated backups, monitoring and regular patch management. Administrative access is separately secured. Your data stays under your control.

approach.title: Approach
approach.note: I use AI tools in development under strict rules. Every change is reviewed, tested and owned by me.

items.title: Requirements analysis
items.text: I map your processes, stakeholders, data flows and constraints such as data protection or accessibility.

items.title: Functional specification and architecture
items.text: Data model, role and permission model, interfaces and operating model. Documented in writing, with effort and milestones.

items.title: Iterative development
items.text: Delivery in milestones on a separate staging environment. You review each stage before it goes live.

items.title: Quality assurance
items.text: Static type checking, validation of all inputs, security and accessibility checks before every release.

items.title: Go-live and handover
items.text: Deployment, technical and user documentation, training for your staff.

items.title: Operations and further development
items.text: Maintenance, monitoring and new features under a service agreement.

items.title: Data sovereignty
items.text: Hosting in Germany, no unnecessary dependence on US cloud services. You always know where your data resides.

items.title: Security by design
items.text: Access control, input validation, rate limiting and encrypted transport are part of the architecture, not added later.

items.title: Maintainability
items.text: TypeScript, established standards and complete documentation. The source code is yours.

items.title: AI with judgement
items.text: Used only where the benefit is clear, with transparent data processing and human oversight.

items.title: Initial consultation (30 minutes, free of charge)
items.text: You outline your project; I provide an initial professional assessment.

items.title: Concept phase (fixed fee, credited upon commission)
items.text: The result is a functional specification covering scope, architecture, effort and timeline, also suitable as a basis for funding or budget applications.

items.title: Development
items.text: A binding quote, invoiced by milestone. For public-sector clients, also across several budget years.

items.title: Service agreement
items.text: Operations, maintenance and further development with agreed response times and a set number of hours.

profile.title: From language to code
profile.text: I studied Romance languages and translation and worked as a self-employed translator for six years. Since 2023 I have been developing software, today from requirements analysis to server operations. The core skill has remained the same: understanding requirements precisely and translating them into a solution that works.

items.title: Do you also build websites?
items.text: Yes, when they need to do more than serve as a digital business card: with a custom CMS, interactive features or as part of an application. My focus is software that solves a specific problem.

items.title: Where is our data stored?
items.text: On servers in Germany. Data protection and data processing agreements are planned from the outset.

items.title: How do you handle sensitive data with AI?
items.text: I select providers and configurations so that your data is not used to train models. Where necessary, personal data is removed before processing, or processing does not take place externally at all.

items.title: Do we own the source code?
items.text: Yes, including documentation. Other developers can continue the work.

items.title: Do you work for public-sector clients?
items.text: Yes. I am familiar with budget reservations and multi-year invoicing.

items.title: What does a project cost?
items.text: The concept phase establishes this. You then receive a binding quote.
